How to Submit Public Comment:

Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of the following
methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the City Clerk
prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3) minutes per person per item. At the Mayor’s
discretion, the time limit may be shortened to allow all speakers to address the City Council.

Electronic submission of Public Comment is also available via the City’s website or by email as noted
below. Public Comment submitted electronically will be read into the record. Words that would disrupt
the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory language, will not be read. Your
comments must be received by 4:30 P.M. on meeting day.

Website: Please submit your comments using the online public comment form at Public Comment.

Watch the Meeting Online

City Council Meeting Videos

Spectrum cable: Live streaming on Channel 3, Public Access Channel.
   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Wednesday, April 10, 2024

  •  CALL TO ORDER
  •  ROLL CALL: Mayor Wu, Vice Mayor Menchaca, Council Members Chan, Ding,
  Harrington

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT

  2. INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE, COMMUNITY
  SERVICES, DESIGN REVIEW, HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL
  RESOURCE, AND PLANNING COMMISSIONS

  The City solicited applications for the Civil Service, Community Services, Design
  Review, Historical Preservation and Cultural Resource and Planning Commissions
  with terms ending May 31, 2024. The Council is requested to conduct interviews
  for the Commissions that have more applicants than positions available and
  consider appointments to all the Commissions listed at the conclusion of the
  interviews.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that the City Council appoint Commissioners upon conclusion
  of the interviews and select individuals they would like to add to the waitlist should
  any vacancies arise during the unexpired term.

  3. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, April 16, 2024, at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

MINUTES OF APRIL 10, 2024
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Wu called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:32 P.M . on
  Tuesday, April 10, 2024, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Eric Chan, Tony Ding, John R. Harrington, Vice Mayor
  Denise Menchaca, and Mayor John Wu
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  Community Development Director Aldo Cervantes,
  Assistant City Attorney Martin Koczanowicz, Assistant
  City Clerk Marilyn Bonus, and Management Assistant
  Adam Yang.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

I  2. INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE, COMMUNITY
  SERVICES, DESIGN REVIEW, HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL
  RESOURCE, AND PLANNING COMMISSIONS

  Assistant City Clerk Bonus announced that interviews would be conducted only for
  those commissions that had more applicants than seats available.

  In response to a question from Vice Mayor Menchaca, Assistant City Attorney
  Koczanowicz explained that while there is no written policy precluding commissioners
  from serving on more than one commission concurrently, historical precedent and a
  statement on the City's website seem to indicate it has been the preference of the City
  Council.

  Interviews of the following applicants were conducted:
  Design Review Commission
